title: cool textures animated
description: This pack upgrades Minecraft with a mix of cool new textures and smooth animated effects that make the world feel more alive.
body: This pack upgrades Minecraft with a mix of cool new textures and smooth animated effects that make the world feel more alive. Surfaces get richer detail, cleaner style, and a more polished look, while select blocks and items feature subtle motion that adds energy and atmosphere without changing the game’s core feel.
